title: MariaDB save intermittently fails with safe-update-mode error while moving connections
author: n3cr0cr0w
body_snippet:
## Description

When using the MariaDB backend, saving the connection list intermittently fails if MariaDB/MySQL safe-update mode is enabled.

The failure is not consistent. While moving connections around in the connection tree, approximately 50% of save attempts produced the safe-update error. Other save attempts completed successfully. When a save succeeds, the entire connection tree is saved.
